title: Polynomial derivative threshold
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real-valued function $p$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define a Boolean function by assigning to each cube point $x$ the sign threshold of the discrete derivative of $p$ in coordinate $i$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
caveat: The upstream definitions of the discrete derivative and sign threshold are not included, so their precise conventions cannot be specified.
